entityDescription:
CarbonPool is a Swiss insurance startup providing credit insurance with claims payments made in-kind, ensuring companies can guarantee the carbon credits that they buy actually materialize. 

Our clientsare developers, corporate buyers and investors who are investing in carbon credits and who need certainty that those credits will be delivered and that the carbon stays sequestered.
Our insurance compensates our clients with high quality carbon credits for unexpected carbon credit shortfalls and reversal events caused by natural catastrophes, weather effects and machine breakdown.
Our expert team of insurance leaders, climate scientists, and experienced risk modelers and underwriters creates bespoke risk models to help our clients understand the risks of their investments, and delivers products to mitigate against them.

entityDescription:
Filiale à 100% du Groupe ADP depuis 2017, Hologarde a été créée pour répondre à un double enjeu : maîtriser le trafic des drones au sein des espaces aériens contrôlés et protéger les sites critiques de la menace des drones.
Ces vecteurs aériens peuvent constituer de réelles opportunités pour de nombreuses activités professionnelles et s’avérer être une menace. C’est dans cet esprit qu’Hologarde a été conçu et développe des solutions qui répondent à ces attentes. 
Donc 3 solutions constituent l’offre Hologarde qui repose sur deux principes : une architecture ouverte (qui permet une interconnectivité totale avec n’importe quel autre appareil) et l’agnosticité des capteurs. 
Les trois solutions sont autant civiles que militaires et/ou étatiques : HoloSafe / BASSALT pour la lutte contre les drones ; HoloSpace / DAD (Direction des Activités Drones) pour UTM & MarineGarde (pour la protection du littoral et de l’offshore). 
Les caractéristiques de réactivité, d’agilité, d’inventivité et de proximité sont les marques de fabrique d’Hologarde et des 40 collaborateurs qui la composent.

entityDescription:
HDES Service & Engineering is a small engineering company founded in February 2018, but with activities going back to 2011. It is active in the development of Cool Gas Generators and management of CGG IP. HDES builds on the work of CGG Technologies BV and CGG Safety & Systems BV, which have been active in Cool Gas Generator Development since 2011. The company is currently located within the ESA Space Business Innovation Centre in Noordwijk.
In 2023, a sister company of HDES was created for the oxygen generator. Both companies share the same experienced technical and management team, which has vast experience in technology development. The team is complemented by a pool of experts who are available for insourcing. The knowledge is documented in reports, test results, drawings, design descriptions, plans and procedures. HDES considers its team’s specific skills and knowledge and its documentation as the core of its competencies.
Since 2026, it was decided that HDES shall focus more on IP management and Solidflow more on development, and that the companies shall slowly transition to their new roles.

(3) Modelling and characterisation of physical processes
(4) IP strategy and IP management

(2) Product development of a CO2 generator for maritime safety applications
(3) Product development of CO2 and other CGGs for space applications
(4) Development of Cool Gas Generators for four space missions, which have operated successfully in space onboard the
Proba-2, Delfi N3xT, InflateSail and RemoveDebris satellites

entityDescription:
Evenor-tech was created in 2009 as a spin-off from Spanish National Research Council. Today, Evenor is a consolidated technology-based company focused on Research, Development and Innovation consultancy for data management, land evaluation, agriculture, ecosystem services and global change, by using statistics techniques, GIS, Earth observations and other co-creative methodologies such as Community of Practice and Digital Marketing.

Evenor participates in European, national and regional strong networks on earth observation, soils, water, ecosystem services and geo-information. Some of them are Copernicus Relay, Global and European Soil Partnership, European Hydropedological Data Inventory from JRC, FORSYS COST Action and REDIAM which represents the Regional Focal point of Andalusia (south of Spain) for the European network of information and observation on the environment (EIONET) promoted and coordinated by the European Environment Agency. In addition, Evenor is always participating at the H2020 program, which increases our networking capacities with reference European centers such as WUR, BOKU and INRA.

The firm has specific experience on environmental and soil data management (database architecture, harmonizing and standardizing), modeling and simulation of land process and conducting scenario analysis, artificial intelligence, ecosystem services analysis, policy advice thanks to the broad experience and multidisciplinary nature of the team.

In the field of data management and processing, statistical techniques such as machine learning or artificial intelligence provide a better solution for huge environmental databases and facilitate the interoperability among different data sources. Evenor has experience on data management and the application of these techniques in several projects such as the European project RECARE, OPERA and CONSOLE. In these projects, we developed pilot’s studies in representative benchmark soil of the Mediterranean region, in order to model ecological processes (regulation of soil contamination, regulation of climate change, regulation of soil water retention, etc) and then up-scale at European results. In addition, close collaboration with academic centers and universities allows the firm to update the statistical techniques and methodologies and improve its capacities.

Regarding the involvement of key actors, Evenor provides experience on Community of Practice development and Digital Marketing applied in R+D+I projects. The CoP approach allows the identification of key players and promotes the exchange of knowledge. This approach is very useful to compile information or opinions from different perspectives. The combination of this approach with Digital Marketing facilitates the increase of numbers of participants through trends analysis and the improvement of communication strategy.

Company description: Irreo is an irrigation automation system with crop monitoring by satellite.
Irreo is a system that allows automatic and efficient management of irrigation on all sectors of a cultivated plot of land, combining an irrigation automation system and a satellite monitoring service for crops and their water requirements without the installation of probes or sensors.
Our algorithms analyse maps from various satellite constellations, both public and private, on a daily basis to estimate the actual evapotranspiration of the crops and provide water to the plants in the right amount and at the right time interval to meet their water needs.
To this end, we have designed and developed electronic control units that, connected to the irrigation system, autonomously manage the flow of water, respecting the constraints and programmes imposed by the farmer, so as to calibrate the irrigation process according to the water needs of each sector of the field.
With Irreo, users can:
- monitor the health, growth and water requirements of crops in the various plots;
- receive an optimal and realistic irrigation schedule for the crops on its field, taking into account the water requirements of the plants on the various sectors, the constraints of the irrigation system, and the user's preferences in terms of rotations and strategies;
- automatically start irrigation, distributing the right amount of water at the right time interval, leaving the user the possibility of managing the system remotely (motor pump, filters, solenoid valves...) through our simple app and thus being able to increase crop yields while reducing working hours, costs and consumption.
With Irreo, the farm can:
- Increase crop yields: produce more with the same amount of water used, also improving the quality of the harvest and reducing the risk of damage or loss;
- increase the work productivity of its employees;
- optimise water use, thereby reducing the energy costs associated with irrigation activities;
- keep crop health under control;
- remotely manage the irrigation system and monitor its proper functioning;
- save on the purchase and maintenance costs of soil moisture sensors.

Ezentis was set up in 1959, initially dedicated to the operation of power installations in Spain. Ezentis was floated in the Stock Market in October 1988 and started its international expansion into the Latin American market. Initially it centred on Chile to fulfil a major contract with Telefonica. Afterwards, operated in Brazil, Peru, Argentina, Colombia, Mexico, Portugal and Germany. It focused its business mainly on the engineering, operation and maintenance of telecommunications and energy network infrastructures, as well as on providing technological solutions for the infrastructures.

After a restructuring plan that took place in 2023, Ezentis currently focuses its operations in Spain on three main areas:
· Communications engineering. This area covers activities such as engineering, design, planning and maintenance of communication systems.
· Security engineering: engineering, installation and maintenance of integrated security systems.
· Technology. This area covers activities such as engineering, design, architecture, consultancy and development of both Systems and Networks, IoT technological solutions for the monitoring of industrial environments, design and manufacturing of communication busters, manufacturing of GIS localization systems and others.

modostudio | cibinel laurenti martocchia architetti associati, located in Rome, is a multidisciplinary practice of architecture, urban planning and industrial design. Profiting from the diversified skills of the founding partners and the continual collaboration with experts from various fields, modostudio combines architectural theory, research, innovation and experimentation with high technical knowledge and professionalism. Established at the end of 2006 by three principal architects, Fabio Cibinel, Roberto Laurenti, and Giorgio Martocchia, after many years of collaborating with internationally acclaimed architects like Massimiliano Fuksas, Piero Sartogo, Erik Van Egeraat and Kas Oosterhuis, modostudio in a short time was awarded and shortlisted in many international architectural competitions. Modostudio partners have been teaching architecture at Cornell University, faculty of architecture in 2008, 2013, 2016, 2018 and 2024, sustainable design at Inarch postgraduate master between 2010 and 2016 and architectural design at IED - European Institute of Design in Rome between 2011 and 2015. Modostudio works have been published in a wide range of specialist literature and exhibited in the Italian Pavillion at 16th and 13th Architecture Biennale (2018, 2012) in Venice, at the 5th Biennale of Public Space in Rome in 2019 and in the Italian Pavillon at Shanghai Expo 2010. Modostudio works have been selected and awarded in several architecture awards including the Rigenera 2022 Awards, the International Prize for Sustainable Architecture 2015, the IQU Award 2015, the KlimaHaus Awards 2015 and 2016, the 27/37 Italian young architects award.DESIGN APPROACHModostudio works are characterized for using experimental and innovative construction materials, which has allowed the studio to acquire a deep experience in the field of construction.

The design approach starts from the analysis of the context, in order to develop innovative proposals, at the same time deeply linked to the territory features.
The studio specializes in buildings design with high technological complexity thanks to an integrated process that involves all the necessary professional skills from the earliest stages of design, pursuing the highest environmental and energy performance certifications.
The entire design process, from the concept phase to the construction design, is constantly monitored and controlled by the use of three-dimensional modeling softwares, with a workflow that is able to operate in BIM methodology, also providing the possibility of VR (virtual reality) enviroment settings.

A focus on the energy and functional building retrofitting led the office to be highly specialized in the design reuse of existing buildings.

Company description: Ukatemi Technologies is a focused, professional engineering company with expertise and demonstrated experience providing high quality and unique cybersecurity services to its Customers. We approach problems with an engineering attitude. We enjoy dissecting things to understand them better, we are excited by designing new solutions, we care about small details in implementation, and we always strive for quality. Our motto is„Driven by challenges”,that means we aim to apply our expertise in protecting applications, systems and services that require high quality of service, reliability and security, and in specific areas where there are no well-developed solutions yet.

Ukatemi was founded in 2012 as a spin-off company of the renowned CrySyS Lab (Laboratory of Cryptography and System Security) of the Budapest University of Technology and Economics. Ukatemi is an independent SME based in Budapest, Hungary.

Our capabilities include evaluating cybersecurity posture, penetration testing and vulnerability assessment, reverse engineering, security by design (systems and processes), incident response, computer forensics, malware analysis, fine-tuning SIEM/SOC solutions as well as designing and performing practice-oriented cybersecurity training and exercises both in IT and OT (ICS/SCADA) environment. We have strong experience in the field of malware analysis and cyber-physical systems security.

Each Ukatemi engineer is an established and skilled professional. Our staff has been involved in the detection and analysis of several publicized targeted malware attacks (including Duqu, Flame, MiniDuke, TeamSpy), custom-tested anti-APT tools, played key roles in large-scale incident management, security and vulnerability assessment and security evaluation of critical information infrastructures; we have provided support to many IT security experts worldwide. Our team of qualified experts has the professional skills and experience needed to deliver the high quality and efficient performance of the activities described in this proposal.

We have:

·deep and robust knowledge in malware analysis, de-obfuscation techniques, and reverse-engineering;
·widespread experience in cyber-physical systems, especially in industrial control systems (including oil and gas; electricity and nuclear power; utility; production; IoT; automotive and transportation);
·access to private malware and threat intelligence feeds and repositories, as well as our own malware repository with more than 600 million malware samples and a collection of 10 million public key certificates;
·custom sandbox environments and malware laboratory, including custom tools;
·experience with various cyber threats including targeted attacks (APTs);

·20 engineering experts (4 with Ph.D, 11 with MsC, 5 with BsC degree) with OSCP, CREST CPSA, CREST CRT, GIAC GPEN, CEH, CISSP,ISO 27001 LA certifications among others.

Project Control Support
DataBase Administration
Quality and Safety insurance
Launcher Strategy
Administrative Assistance/Interpreter
Software development
IT Support and IT Tools
Electronic data transfer
JPSI provides Project Control Support to several ESA directorates (HRE, STS, D&P, NAV). This support includes Project Controllers, IPCDB operators and DataBase/Application Administrators. The core of the management Information system is an ESA tool called IPCDB (Integrated Project Control DataBase), which is a synthesis tool (CA/PA profile, Budget, Geographical return, contractual data etc…) at planning and actuals level.

Project control
Launcher Strategy
Administrative support
ASSET Management.

entityDescription:
Founded in 2013, Iconem is currently active in around fifty countries to promote the conservation of cultural heritage threatened by looting, urbanization, mass tourism, armed conflicts, and climate change. Its team of approximately 20 people develops large-scale 3D scanning solutions for natural and cultural sites, enabling their recording at very high resolution. Since its inception, the company has been committed to heritage preservation in partnership with international organizations, governments and municipalities, or internationally renowned museums such as UNESCO, the Aga Khan Trust for Culture, the Sultanate of Oman, the City of Paris, or the Louvre Museum. Its 3D models of monuments, urban or rural heritage on a large scale, and its training programs dedicated to professionals facilitate the essential work of conservation and restoration experts.

Resulting from its partnership with Inria and Microsoft Research, Iconem's technology is based on AI and its computer vision algorithms, enabling us to become a leader in photorealistic 3D scanning of cultural heritage sites. The use of AI for the preservation and promotion of cultural heritage is a rapidly growing field, and collaboration between technology companies, cultural institutions, and researchers is essential to harness the potential of AI in real-time detection of heritage destruction. Real-time monitoring of the conservation status and dynamics of destruction of global cultural heritage is now made possible by the use of satellite imagery and automated change detection technologies.

Our methodological approach consists of a complete chain for the protection of endangered cultural heritage sites, including active monitoring through site observation, identifying risks, and their prevention, detection and characterization of damage, and potential preventive measures, as well as for conservation/restoration.
